integrity: Exact rational finite counterexample; symbolic proof via explicit interpolation matrices and entrywise asymptotic limit. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Standard interpolatory BDF3 for a scalar negative-real test eigenvalue on a strictly alternating mesh. The universal result is a fixed-q, r-to-infinity limit and corresponding eventual stability/instability; no finite-r classification at q=1, multivariate or nonlinear stability, arbitrary grids, or accuracy claims.
title: A sharp large-ratio damping reversal for alternating variable-step BDF3
